		Introduction
	

SWE-QA-Pro SFT Trajectories is a set of agentic tool-use trajectories for repository-level question answering, used as the supervised fine-tuning (SFT) data in the SWE-QA-Pro training recipe.
Each item is a multi-turn trajectory in which an agent answers a repository-grounded question by exploring the codebase with read-only tools rather than relying on memorized knowledge.
